ns2:section.sectionText: All seats in NRES 420 will be restricted to NRES majors until December 7, 2020, when any remaining seats will be made available to students in other majors. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions, to be held during the scheduled class day/time listed in Course Explorer. Register for the Online Lecture and the Online Lab. If all seats are full, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist to be added to the waiting list. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
